sceneLabel: 3D playground. Click to control your character.
unsupported: This browser could not open the 3D world (WebGL is off or unavailable). You are still in the call and hear everyone as usual.

hint.desktop: Click or drag the scene to look around / WASD walks / double-tap W sprints / Shift sneaks / Space jumps / V switches camera / Tab opens the menu
hint.touch: Drag on the left to walk and on the right to look around

camera.toThird: Switch to third person, from behind
camera.toFront: Switch to third person, from the front

screen.idleHint: Share your screen for everyone to watch here
screen.taken: Someone else is already on the big screen. Wait until they stop sharing to stream.

menu.title: Menu
menu.hint: Tab or Esc returns to the game / arrows choose / Enter confirms

errors.dimensions: A skin must be a 64×64 (or 64×32) PNG.
errors.size: That file is too large for a skin.
errors.unreadable: That file could not be read as an image.
errors.save: The skin could not be saved. Try again.

hud.sharing: You are on the big screen
